rule: Every data element maps to current explicit purpose and protocol question
Only listed events and properties are authorized
Consent state and version are recorded when consent is legal basis or ethical requirement
failure_behavior: no collection or isolate pending lawful basis

rule: Prospective collection stops; deletion/retention follows declared policy and obligations
anonymous, pseudonymous or identified is declared by data class
Each data class has duration or event-based rule
Role, purpose, scope and audit requirement are explicit
Export purpose, fields, identifiers, format and recipient are declared
Requires compatible purpose and explicit approval/consent where applicable
Key separation and re-identification authority are explicit
Accessibility, accommodation, identity and qualitative data receive restricted access
Operational logs are not learning analytics by default
Participant-facing explanation covers data, purpose, access, retention and rights
Research-data incidents have notification, containment and audit process
Mappings include semantic version, lossiness and conformance evidence
